## Canonical promotion queue — restatedev/restate

**This issue is the only repo-level upstream promotion queue for `restatedev/restate`.** Original fork/origin PRs, individual QA issues, proof and authorship stay in place and must be **linked here**, not re-posted. [Factory #14](https://github.com/kvnloo/oss-factory/issues/14) is a cross-repository index only; older work-order rows below are **historical** until exact-head requalification. Existing origin reviewer feedback and CI outrank new claims. **No automatic posting, default merges or proof upgrades.**

**Current triage:** [#5507 indexing source finding](https://github.com/kvnloo/restate/commit/6b75c0d8cdcc1d3e034a0feceda8157f357dcebb) is **LIMITED / CHECK** with no native workspace compilation; [#5538](https://github.com/restatedev/restate/pull/5538) and [#5517](https://github.com/restatedev/restate/pull/5517) are existing owner reviews, not new factory PRs. **No verified new-origin-ready item** currently recorded. Credit source owners and preserve review provenance.

**For every item:** identify original reporter/author and origin URL; behavior **and separate requirement** evidence; exact fork/origin SHA, baseline→head commands/results and limitations; maintainer reviews/CI/duplicates; scoped human authorization; then record the posted origin URL or merged/closed/superseded disposition. This queue is an index, not fresh validation.

---


## Canonical per-repo promotion queue — 2026-10-16
This existing project issue is the **single authoritative promotion queue** for `restatedev/restate` (Restate); [factory dashboard #14](https://github.com/kvnloo/oss-factory/issues/14) is only the cross-repository index. REGISTRY_PENDING. The historical evidence records, ownership, credit and links below are preserved, not upgraded to current READY or reallocated. Do not open a competing per-repo promotion tracker.

**Current state rule:** `READY_FOR_HITL` requires independent requirement proof, exact-head source and native checks, maintainer feedback/CI, owner/duplicate/policy review, and a minimal authorized proposal. The actual Linear origin-write gate remains separate. `IN_REVIEW` already has an origin URL; `LANDED` only after merge SHA verification. Otherwise `CHECK/LIMITED/HOLD/WAIT/DISCARDED` and one exact unblocker. Historical work remains historical until rechecked.

Append/check one row per distinct contribution using its original origin issue/PR, fork SHA and source, executed test commands/results, current feedback, contributor credit, disposition and next action. Mirror only newly qualified READY rows to the #14 index. Do not create new per-repo queue issues or publish origin changes without HITL.

---

## Per-item acceptance and update contract
- Link each origin issue/PR to exactly one canonical downstream work record where available.
- Record tested origin SHA, fork SHA, branch, exact commands, RED/GREEN or review evidence, independent QA, limits, owner, disposition and next action.
- Keep source-only, mocked, native CPU, native desktop and live-provider results distinct.
- Append timestamped result/blocker receipts; preserve earlier failures and author credit.
- Mirror only freshly qualified publication candidates to `#14`. Hermes handles authorized origin publication; this card grants no origin write, merge, signoff or permission recovery.
- Historical backfill is ongoing. Unknown branch names, exact commands, current origins or registry prerequisites remain gates.
